notes.title: Steam Deck Verified!
notes.notes:
I'm proud to announce that the game has official "Verified" compatibility with Steam Deck!
Read the story at the comfort of the portable device!

Theoretically, the recent update should also improve experience on other handheld devices or smaller screens. I also reconfigured cloud saves so you could seamlessly switch devices and continue the story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44773759/d3ee09cb7e9bfb5f94650dfe4207396c643d4102.jpg[/img]
Steam Deck unit provided for testing and development courtesy of Valve.

notes.title: v1.0.1 - January 7th 2025
notes.notes:
- slight updates to UI
- changes to Steam Cloud and Steam Input

This update is meant to improve the experience on Steam Deck and other devices with smaller screen.

notes.title: DIE IN ANOTHER WORLD TODAY!
notes.notes:
I'm happy to announce that the game is now available!
Dive into a mysterious land, try to solve the murder... and see where the story goes!

This is so far my biggest and most ambitious title yet, I hope you'll enjoy it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2713990/I_keep_Dying_in_Another_World_What_the_hell_Goddess/

And as usual, if you own my previous games or missing a few, there's a special bundle discount!
